description.desc_thousand_char: Printotech Global Limited (PGL), as per its credit rating, is engaged in the business of manufacturing co-extruded seamless and laminated tubes. It produces soft squeeze co-extruded seamless plastic tubes. It has a presence in Europe, the United States, Asia, and Africa. The company has an installed capacity of 270 million ABL laminated tubes, 30 million PBL laminated tubes, and 100 million co-extruded seamless tubes per annum. It is an ISO certified company. Its clientele includes Cipla, P&G, Leeford, Godrej, Patanjali, and Himalaya, among others. The company was incorporated in 1993 and has its registered office located in Delhi.
